name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta and Catamarca provinces, Argentina. The flagship asset hosts proven and probable mineral reserves of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold in a fully permitted, DFS-complete open-pit project. The company completed its Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 and is targeting a Final Investment Decision in Q2 2027, with first production planned for 2029.
